items.title: Truist Names Harold Ford Jr. as Adviser
items.summary: Truist Financial named a former U.S. congressman, Harold Ford Jr., as a vice chairman and strategic adviser.  Ford has worked in banking and finance since departing the House of Representatives in 2007, most recently at PNC Financial Services Group.

items.title: Nvidia’s GPU Price Hikes Look Bad for CoreWeave. Truist Says the Opposite May Be True
items.summary: CoreWeave, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWV) stock should have been under pressure following news that NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) is reportedly hiking prices for its GPUs by roughly 17%. With GPUs at the heart of CRWV’s infrastructure, expensive chips should have automatically compressed the company’s margins. Truist says this doesn’t have to be true. items.title: NVDA Stock Posts Biggest Jump In 14 Months On $12 Trillion Valuation Call From Raymond James – ‘Supply Is The Primary Constraint’
items.summary: Raymond James raised its Nvidia price target to $515 from $352, implying a market value of roughly $12.4 trillion if it reaches that level.

items.summary: Rosenblatt called the settlement a significant win for Meta, noting that the payments represent only about 1% of Meta’s market value.

items.title: CRM Stock Rips To 6-Month High In Biggest Single-Day Gain Since 2020: Analysts Call Salesforce Q2 ‘Narrative-Changing’
items.summary: Wall Street analysts responded to Salesforce Q2 earnings with a wave of price-target hikes, with Raymond James setting the highest target at $310.

items.title: Will ITUB's U.S. Bank Charter Expand Its Wealth Banking Franchise?
items.summary: Itau Unibanco's U.S. bank charter approval is set to expand its Miami wealth franchise by broadening banking services for affluent Latin American clients.

items.title: Wall Street Moves on MAA, Rivian and Design Therapeutics: One Upgrade, One Target Trim and a Biotech on Watch
items.summary: An EV maker on the rebound, a Sun Belt landlord facing fresh headwinds, and a clinical-stage biotech sitting on pivotal pipeline data have all landed on analysts' radars this week for very different reasons.
